coverage.source: ESRS Set 1 delegated act — cross-cutting and topical standards
coverage.caveat: Extract of the cross-cutting standards and the most deal-relevant E1/S1/G1 disclosure requirements. ESRS Set 1 contains roughly 1,100 data points and materiality determines which apply; this pack cannot support a completeness assertion. Verify against the delegated act and the entity's own materiality assessment.

requirements.requirement_description: Disclose the basis of preparation, consolidation scope and value chain boundary.

requirements.requirement_name: Role of administrative and supervisory bodies
requirements.requirement_description: Disclose the composition, expertise and sustainability oversight role of governance bodies.
Disclose whether and how sustainability performance is reflected in remuneration.
Disclose material IROs identified by the double materiality assessment and their interaction with strategy.
Describe the process to identify and assess material impacts, risks and opportunities.

requirements.requirement_name: Transition plan for climate change mitigation
requirements.requirement_description: Disclose a transition plan compatible with limiting warming to 1.5C, including decarbonisation levers.
Disclose GHG emission reduction targets with base year, target year and scope coverage.
Disclose total energy consumption split by fossil, nuclear and renewable sources.
Disclose gross Scope 1 GHG emissions in tCO2e and the percentage under regulated emission trading schemes.
Disclose gross location-based and market-based Scope 2 GHG emissions in tCO2e.
Disclose gross Scope 3 GHG emissions by significant category with the calculation basis.
Disclose GHG removals and any carbon credits cancelled or planned to be cancelled.

requirements.requirement_name: Anticipated financial effects of climate risk
requirements.requirement_description: Disclose anticipated financial effects from material physical and transition risks.
Disclose total water consumption, and consumption in areas of water stress.
Disclose material resource inflows including the share of secondary reused or recycled components.
Disclose total waste generated, diverted from disposal and directed to disposal.
Disclose headcount by gender and country, and employee turnover.
Disclose gender distribution at top management and the age distribution of employees.
Disclose recordable work-related injuries, fatalities and days lost.
Disclose procedures to prevent, detect and address allegations of corruption and bribery.
